summary.learning_goal: Inspect anatomical systems and spatial relationships, with 2,234 modeled pieces.
summary.primary_visualization: Full-body 3D model plus an exploded part inventory.
summary.primary_interaction: Choose an anatomical system and change the assembled-to-exploded slider.

strengths: Source panel identifies the adult male reference, mesh-versus-concept distinction and illustrative system colors.
weaknesses: No independent anatomy audit; general context does not explain each structure or biological function.

strengths: Skeleton filtering and reversible explosion reveal parts hidden by surrounding tissue.
weaknesses: The full inventory is cognitively dense and lacks a guided explanatory sequence; filtering Heart leaves it small in the original body framing.

strengths: Full-body tissues and isolated skeleton share an aligned coordinate frame; exploded layout separates 296 bone pieces.
weaknesses: Tiny structures become difficult to identify at inventory scale; Heart filtering leaves substantial unused viewport.

strengths: System selection changes the visible count and geometry; slider End changes 0% assembly to 100% inventory and Reset reverses it.
weaknesses: Some controls require further inspection to understand; search, direct picking and focus were not exercised in this run.

strengths: The light stage, restrained system panel and bottom slider keep the body prominent.
weaknesses: Initial geometry loading required an explicit readiness wait; the mobile capture covers the source panel rather than the full exploration workflow.

principles_to_learn: Pair visibility filters with the spatial representation.
Preserve the assembled coordinate frame as the reference state.
Filter before exploding to limit visual overload.
Include source and model scope within the product.
things_not_to_copy: Do not assume a 2,234-part catalogue teaches physiological function.
Do not leave a small selected system tiny in a full-body camera frame.
golden_recommendation: Use for system filtering, exploded view, camera presets. Use principles with the documented limitations.
